This stage takes the talk from Part 1 of the slides and installs the tools. It takes about five and a quarter hours.

## 1. The talk of Part 1

**On the slides.** Read each slide with its speaker notes.

## 2. Task 1 – The setup check

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Download the IDE workspace (zip)]({{< var cases.housing.workspace-zip >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

Install R, Quarto and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) by following the setup page. Then download the IDE workspace, unzip it, open the folder that it makes, `ar4ds-housing-workspace-main`, in your IDE (in RStudio, the file `ar4ds-housing-workspace.Rproj` inside it), and run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until every line prints OK. The last check prints −19.97 percentage points. Open the [slides at Task 1](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){target="_blank"} or the [webR workspace](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup) once as well, either of which runs every task in a browser tab if your installation fails. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that others have met.

## 3. The case study and the exercise {#the-case-and-the-exercise}

[Open the home page](../../index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the section on the case study and the section on the exercise.

## 4. The glossary

[Open the glossary](../../resources.qmd#glossary){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the glossary. Then write a paragraph in your own words that tells reproduction, robustness and replication apart and says what each of them found on the case study.

## 5. Your IDE

[Open the module on the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [What an IDE does](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-what) in the module on the AR4DS website, and the sections on the IDE that you chose, sections 2 to 8 for Positron and [section 10](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-other) for RStudio and VS Code. Then work through [the six steps](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/ide.html#sec-try) at the end of the module, in the IDE workspace that you have just installed.

## 6. R from the beginning

[Open Getting started with R](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work from [R and the IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-what) to [Packages](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/r.html#sec-packages) in the module on the AR4DS website, whose blocks run in your browser.

**Shortcuts.** If R, Quarto and an IDE are already on your machine, download the IDE workspace, run the check and install what it reports as missing, which takes about a quarter of an hour. If you already work in one of the three IDEs, take only the six steps of the IDE module. If you write R, leave the R module until stage 2, which says what to read in it.
